description: A `${…}` in a static `<md>` body is text and re-renders when its cell changes; the markdown structure around it never changes.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY)
rationale: §67.4: an atom renders exactly as `${expr}` renders in a markup body (§7.4.2) — its string value as a text node, reactive when it reads a cell (only that text re-renders; the structure never changes). An atom in a heading contributes nothing to the slug.
